problems.title: CAC rising
problems.evidence: Meta Ads CAC rose 50% to $150 while ROAS declined to 2.0x.

problems.title: AI visibility low
problems.evidence: The company appeared in only 2 of 5 high-intent AI search prompts.

actions.title: Create Campaign
actions.output: A focused Google Search campaign with a $5k budget and a 3.2x ROAS target.

actions.title: GEO Plan
actions.output: A comparison-content plan for the missing high-intent AI search prompts.
actions.guardrail: Evidence and rationale recorded in the Action Ledger

future.title: Growth Passport
future.description: A portable, founder-controlled record of verified growth execution.

future.title: Growth Capital
future.description: Capital matched to measurable growth readiness and trusted operating history.

stages.label: Problem
stages.title: A five-person startup cannot hire a Growth Team.
stages.objective: Establish the founder's growth constraint in one sentence.
stages.presenter_cue: Open with the founder: $30k MRR, five people, but acquisition is getting more expensive and AI discovery is weak.

stages.label: Connect Data
stages.title: Three accounts become one operating picture.
stages.objective: Show the exact business sources without a setup detour.
stages.presenter_cue: Move once across Stripe, Google Ads, and Meta Ads. Each source contributes one decision-grade signal.

stages.label: AI Diagnosis
stages.title: GrowthOS finds the two constraints behind the score.
stages.objective: Explain the Growth Score, then ground both problems in evidence.
stages.presenter_cue: Lead with 68 out of 100. Then connect the rising CAC to paid data and low visibility to the GEO scan.

stages.label: Agent Execution
stages.title: Two agents turn diagnosis into controlled action.
stages.objective: Show the campaign draft, GEO plan, approval gate, and auditability.
stages.presenter_cue: Contrast recommendation with execution: the GEO plan is ready, while the campaign remains protected by founder approval.

stages.label: Future
stages.title: Trusted growth execution becomes a portable asset.
stages.objective: Close on the future direction without presenting it as a current feature.
stages.presenter_cue: End with the bridge: today's trusted execution can become tomorrow's Growth Passport and Growth Capital layer.
